posts.label: Market Update
posts.alt: Scottsdale market update post: condo buyers have more choice
posts.caption: Condo buyers in Scottsdale have more choice. In October, townhouses and condos had 6.6 months of supply, up from 5.5 a year ago, and 1,127 townhouses and condos were for sale, 12% more than a year ago. More options means more room to compare. Source: Phoenix REALTORS, ARMLS data, October 2026. #ScottsdaleAZ #ScottsdaleRealEstate

posts.alt: Selling this season? Decorate light seller tip post
posts.caption: Selling this season? Decorate light. Keep decor simple and neutral so photos and showings keep the focus on the home. A few touches feel warm. Too many hide the rooms buyers came to see. #ScottsdaleAZ #HomeSellingTips
